## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior or mathematical statement.

## Evidence

- Commands run and results:

## Review checks

- [ ] I can explain the contribution and have checked its claims.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute this material under the project license.
- [ ] No private data, credentials or workstation paths are included.
- [ ] Proof or behavior changes have the appropriate reproducible checks.
